text:
arjun: Ran a profiling sweep on PP8 (24B) with microbatch=4, default 1F1B. Seeing a persistent pipeline "barge" where stage 6/7 stalls on all-reduce waits up to ~45ms per step. @maya can you take a look at the traces?

maya: uploaded trace link: https://internal.prof/runs/1792006290 — TL;DR: comm tail + KV-cache refill spikes align at microbatch boundaries. p95 stall concentrated on last 2 microbatches.

leo: quick profiler snippet pasted:```
stage,compute_ms,comm_ms,stall_ms
0,18,5,2
1,20,6,1
2,17,4,3
3,15,6,5
4,14,7,6
5,13,10,12
6,12,45,80  # huge stall during all-reduce
7,10,50,95
```

emily: hypothesis: a lot of small-tensor allreduces (many op-level reductions) are saturating NVLINK/NCCL startup. Also kernel-selection heuristic is picking non-fused attention for seq_len=512 in a few layers — that increases op count and fragments comm.

sean: experimented locally: changed microbatch_size from 4 -> 8, enabled overlap_allreduce=true, comm_num_streams=2, kernel_policy=prefer_fused. Short run results: throughput +9%, p95 latency +12% during warmup but steady-state bubble tail reduced ~60%.

arjun: logs show KV cache misses aligning with the step boundary where we evict and refill > causing synchronous host->device copies. Suggest adding kv_prefetch:true and kv_batch_align:8 so refills happen earlier/in parallel.

maya: queued a job with config bump (microbatch:8, overlap_allreduce:true, nccl_algo:tree, kv_prefetch:true) — run id 1792006290. I'll attach flamegraphs when done.

dev-prof-bot: scheduled run 1792006290 with configs: {"microbatch": "8", "overlap_allreduce": "true", "nccl_algo": "tree", "kv_prefetch": "true"}. Expected runtime ~3h.

leo: note — switching to async_allreduce exposed a regression in the kernel autotuner: attention kernel fallback path triggers extra memcpy for GPU0 (~3ms/forward). Filed issue #PROF-487 with repro and perf traces.

emily: suggestion for autotuner: add a weighted penalty so it avoids fallback to scalar-softmax for seq_len > 256 unless memory wins by >10%. That should reduce fragmentation.

arjun: action items: (1) maya: run 24h sweep with the config above and attach end-to-end traces; (2) leo: PR to autotuner adding the fallback penalty; (3) emily: add a microbatch=8 1F1B perf regression test in CI.

maya: ack :thumbsup: I'll post run outputs to the trace link and tag the thread.

sean: we'll monitor p95 and bubble metrics in the perf dashboard; if p95 > target we'll roll back config via canary.

arjun: good. one more thing — consider batching-heuristic tweak: coalesce small allreduces into a single fused op for tensors < 64KB per child; prototype showed lower latency variance.

leo: noted, prototype patch lands in a branch: perf/comm-fuse-small-tensors. I'll add microbench results.

emily: thanks everyone. keep short logs and flamegraphs attached to run id 1792006290.

arjun: thread closed for now, reopen if new regressions surface or if the autotuner change flips perf unexpectedly.
